import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import warnings
import os
import re

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
with open("./input/train/train.json", "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)
with open("./input/test/test.json", "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Verify submission template
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sampleSubmission.csv")


# Text feature engineering function
def extract_text_features(text_series):
    features = pd.DataFrame()
    text_series = text_series.fillna("")

    # Length features
    features["text_len"] = text_series.str.len()
    features["word_count"] = text_series.str.split().str.len()
    features["avg_word_len"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: np.mean([len(w) for w in x.split()]) if len(x.split()) > 0 else 0
    )

    # Punctuation and style
    features["exclamation_count"] = text_series.str.count("!")
    features["question_count"] = text_series.str.count("\?")
    features["uppercase_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for c in x if c.isupper())
    )
    features["uppercase_ratio"] = features["uppercase_count"] / (
        features["text_len"] + 1
    )
    features["sentiment_positive"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(
            re.findall(
                r"\b(thank|thanks|appreciate|great|amazing|awesome|bless|kind|grateful)\b",
                x.lower(),
            )
        )
    )
    features["sentiment_negative"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(re.findall(r"\b(sad|bad|worried|hurt|sadness)\b", x.lower()))
    )
    features["politeness"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(
            re.findall(
                r"\b(please|if you could|could you|would be great|appreciate it)\b",
                x.lower(),
            )
        )
    )
    features["emoji_count"] = text_series.apply(
        lambda x: len(re.findall(r"[^\w\s,']", x)) if x else 0
    )
    features["line_breaks"] = text_series.str.count("\n").fillna(0)

    return features


# Extract features using only columns available in both train and test sets
def extract_features(df, is_train=True):
    # Base numeric features (only those present in test data)
    numeric_base = [
        "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
        "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
        "unix_timestamp_of_request",
        "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
    ]

    # Only include columns that exist in the dataframe
    numeric_base = [col for col in numeric_base if col in df.columns]

    X_numeric = df[numeric_base].fillna(0).astype(float)

    # Create subreddit count feature
    X_categorical = pd.DataFrame()
    if "requester_subreddits_at_request" in df.columns:
        X_categorical["subreddit_count"] = df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].apply(
            lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
        )

    # Combine title and edit-aware text
    text_cols_data = (
        df["request_title"].fillna("") + " " + df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
    )

    X_text_eng = extract_text_features(text_cols_data)

    return X_numeric, text_cols_data, X_categorical, X_text_eng


X_numeric_train, X_text_train, X_categorical_train, X_text_eng_train = extract_features(
    train_df, is_train=True
)
y_train = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].values.astype(int)

X_numeric_test, X_text_test, X_categorical_test, X_text_eng_test = extract_features(
    test_df, is_train=False
)

tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=100, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english")
X_text_tfidf_train = tfidf.fit_transform(X_text_train)
X_text_tfidf_test = tfidf.transform(X_text_test)

X_numeric_sparse_train = csr_matrix(X_numeric_train.values)
X_categorical_sparse_train = csr_matrix(X_categorical_train.values)
X_text_eng_sparse_train = csr_matrix(X_text_eng_train.values)

X_numeric_sparse_test = csr_matrix(X_numeric_test.values)
X_categorical_sparse_test = csr_matrix(X_categorical_test.values)
X_text_eng_sparse_test = csr_matrix(X_text_eng_test.values)

X_train_sparse = hstack(
    [
        X_text_tfidf_train,
        X_numeric_sparse_train,
        X_categorical_sparse_train,
        X_text_eng_sparse_train,
    ]
)
X_test_sparse = hstack(
    [
        X_text_tfidf_test,
        X_numeric_sparse_test,
        X_categorical_sparse_test,
        X_text_eng_sparse_test,
    ]
)

# Train-validation split
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_sparse, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train_split, y_train_split)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val_split, y_val_split, reference=lgb_train)

params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val_split)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test_sparse)

# Create submission dataframe
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": y_test_pred}
)

# Ensure submission matches sample submission format exactly
submission = submission[["request_id", "requester_received_pizza"]]
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
